$comment: The public surface of pkinative under semantic versioning, generated by scripts/build-api-frozen.ts: every export of src/index.ts with its kind and a canonical signature (read from the syntax tree of its module; comments, parameter names and member order removed — scripts/lib/api-surface.ts), and every reason code. The api-surface-frozen rule of scripts/verify-docs.ts holds the sources to it. phase "rehearsal" (0.8.x-0.9.x): any addition, removal or signature change fails, and so does any error or reason code the snapshots do not list. phase "stable" (from 1.0.0): a removal or an incompatible change is semver-major and fails; an addition is semver-minor. Error codes are frozen by docs/data/errors.frozen.json; diagnostic codes are never frozen.
